title: 'Athar' - an advanced platform that cuts 75% of the evidence-exhibit and evidence tracking path (Dubai Police, GITEX Global 2022)
title_ar: «أثر» منصة متطوّرة تختزل 75% من مسار الأحراز والأدلة
key_findings: Dubai Police's General Department of Forensic Evidence unveiled a digital platform named «أثر» on its GITEX Global 2022 stand; it tracks evidence exhibits (أحراز), evidence and cases end-to-end and collapses four manual stages into one.

Designed in-house by Dubai Police experts and described as AI-driven; claimed to cut processing time by at least 75%. Spokesperson: Maj. Gen. (اللواء) Ahmed Thani bin Ghalita (Director, General Department of Forensic Evidence). [Corrected/Clarified 2026-10-27 by deep-card review]
The article does not give a formal launch date, does not say whether the platform is public-facing, and names no partner company.
athar_applications: Earliest dated public use of «أثر» by Dubai Police (Oct 2022): an internal/B2G evidence-management tool, not a consumer app, game or education service.

Overlap with ATHAR is conceptual (forensic evidence, 'trace'), not commercial: different goods/services and audience - but a forensic-mystery product called «أثر» in the UAE could still suggest affiliation with Dubai Police.
limitations: Press report of an institutional statement; no Dubai Police primary page found; no trademark registration located (UAE register not publicly searchable).

title: How 270,000 crime-scene traces helped Dubai Police investigations (mentions 'Athar Digital Platform')
key_findings: English-language coverage names the tool 'Athar Digital Platform' and lists it among the key innovations of the Crime Scene Department (General Department of Forensic Science and Criminology), streamlining evidence management and crime-scene operations.
Shows the name is still in active institutional use and publicised in English in Oct 2026, four years after the 2022 unveiling.
athar_applications: Confirms the Latin spelling 'Athar' is used by Dubai Police in English media - the conflict is not limited to the Arabic script.
SEO/brand-confusion risk in UAE English media searches for 'Athar' + 'crime scene'/'evidence'.
limitations: Journalistic summary; one-line mention; no details on users, ownership of any mark or public availability.

title: Apple App Store - Dubai Police General Head Quarter developer catalogue (iTunes Lookup API, AE storefront)
key_findings: The Dubai Police General Head Quarter developer account lists 11 apps in the UAE storefront (e.g. 'Dubai Police - شرطة دبي', Esaad Card, Efaad, Officers Club, My Child My Friend, Stay Safe); none is named Athar/أثر.
Combined with the press reports, the evidence indicates «أثر» is an internal forensic workflow platform, not a public store app.
athar_applications: No direct app-store collision with Dubai Police; the risk is affiliation/confusion and government sensitivity, not a store-name block.
limitations: Snapshot of one storefront on one date; a web-only or enterprise-distributed tool would not appear in the App Store.

title: Apple App Store search snapshot: apps named Athar/Athr/أثر in AE, SA, EG, KW, QA, JO and LB storefronts (iTunes Search API, 2026-10-27)
title_ar: رصد متجر آبل: تطبيقات باسم «أثر/Athar» في سبعة متاجر عربية
edition_version: Queries 'athar', 'أثر', 'athr', 'athar game', 'athar education', 'athar mystery', 'أثر لغز'; limit 50 per query; 27 Oct 2026
key_findings: 36 distinct apps with Athar/Athr/أثر in the title surfaced across AE/SA/EG/KW queries (17-22 per storefront in QA/JO/LB); most were released in 2025-2026, i.e. the name is crowded and growing.

22 of 36 are religious-themed (prayer times, adhkar, Quran, hadith, Islamic-history streaming or games); the rest include an education LLC ('Aathar' by ATHAR EDUCATIONAL LLC), study aids ('أثر- ادرس بذكاء', 'Athar Academy'), journaling, shopping and an AR heritage guide ('AthAR+' by Atharcom FZC, a UAE free-zone company).
Exactly one game: 'Athar: Echoes of Time' (Siraaj Studios LTD, strategy card game, released 14 Aug 2026), present in AE, EG, KW, QA, JO and LB storefronts.
athar_applications: A bare 'Athar'/'أثر' store title is not distinctive: search for the name returns dozens of mostly religious apps - poor discoverability and likely user confusion.
If the name is kept, the store title must carry a distinctive element (e.g. «أثر: <distinctive word>») and the developer name should be AIJUR.
limitations: The Search API caps results (50 per query) and ranks by relevance; counts are lower bounds. Titles only, not trademarks. Store contents change daily.

title: Athar: Echoes of Time - strategy card game inspired by Islamic history (Siraaj Studios LTD) - App Store, Google Play and official site
edition_version: iOS v0.8.0 released 14 Aug 2026 (rated 9+, English, free); Google Play package com.yzza.athar (100+ downloads); site athar.siraaj.uk (redirect from playathar.com)
key_findings: A live mobile game branded 'ATHAR' (title 'Athar: Echoes of Time') by Siraaj Studios LTD: a strategy card game with cards based on Islamic scholars, warriors and historical figures; early access; available in at least the UK, UAE, Egypt, Kuwait, Qatar, Jordan, Lebanon and Saudi Arabia App Stores (iTunes Lookup re-check of 8 storefronts, 2026-10-27; English only, 0-2 ratings each) and on Google Play. [Corrected/Clarified 2026-10-27 by deep-card review]
The official site markets it as 'ATHAR' and uses the tagline idea 'trace the steps / discover the legacy' - same word, same core sense (trace/legacy), same goods category (games, class 9/28/41).
athar_applications: Closest real-world conflict for ATHAR: same name, same product type (mobile game), overlapping Arab/Muslim audience. Even without a registration, prior use and store presence create passing-off/confusion risk and app-store name-dispute risk.
Counsel should check UK IPO (and EUIPO/US) for any filing by Siraaj Studios; our USPTO and WIPO Madrid searches found none on 27 Oct 2026.
limitations: UK IPO register is CAPTCHA-protected and was not searched; company details not verified at Companies House; download figures are Google Play bands.

title: Google Play search and detail pages for 'athar' / 'أثر' (gl=AE), 2026-10-27
edition_version: Search pages (q=athar, q=أثر, q=athar game) and 7 detail pages fetched 27 Oct 2026
key_findings: Search 'athar' returned 16 app packages and 'أثر' 29 packages (many unrelated popular apps mixed in); Athar-named apps include a Quran/adhkar app (com.ahmedmostafa.athar, 1K+), Quran study circles ('أثر', com.atharacademy.athar_academy), memories/diary apps, 'Al Athar - Explore Islamic Heritage Sites', 'Athar Festival' conference app and 'Athar: Echoes of Time' (Siraaj Studios, 100+).
Google Play mirrors the App Store picture: crowded, mostly religious/heritage connotation, one game.
athar_applications: Same conclusion as the iOS snapshot: bare 'Athar' is weak and crowded in stores; use a distinctive compound title.
limitations: Google Play search is personalised and not exhaustive; HTML scraped once; download counts are bands.

title: Steam store search for 'athar', 'athr', 'aathar', 'أثر' (storesearch API, cc=AE) and Atharia app details
key_findings: No Steam title named 'Athar' or 'أثر'. 'athar' returns only 'Atharia' (Symbolics Games; turn-based creature-collecting roguelite, coming 2027) and its demo; 'athr' returns unrelated titles (Athralis Tower Defense, A Thread Between).
athar_applications: PC/Steam channel is clear for an 'ATHAR' title; 'Atharia' is a different word and genre - low risk.
limitations: Steam search is prefix/fuzzy; unreleased titles without store pages are invisible.

title: USPTO trademark search - live and dead records containing ATHAR / ATHR / AATHAR and transliterations (tmsearch backend), 2026-10-27
authors: United States Patent and Trademark Office
edition_version: Queried 27 Oct 2026 (wordmark, pseudo-mark, transliteration and translation fields)
key_findings: Live US records with ATHAR/ATHR as the dominant word: THE ATHAR FOUNDATION (Reg. 6775046, cl.41 - charitable/education mentoring and workshops; owner Ronald Smith; reg. 28 Jun 2022); ATHAR (serial 50140770, cl.40 laser engraving; filed 1 Oct 2026, not yet examined); ATHR BEAUTY (Reg. 6647635, cl.3); ATHRZ (Reg. 7092560, cl.9 headphones/game headsets); ATHARA (Reg. 7899384, cl.25). Also live in cl.41: ATHRÚ (Reg. 7756081; business/leadership training for corporations; owner National Employee Assistance Providers, Inc.) - low conflict risk but same class. [Corrected/Clarified 2026-10-27 by deep-card review]

No live US mark ATHAR/ATHR for software, games (cl.9/28) or online entertainment (cl.41 games). Dead records include ATHARA PUBLICATIONS (cl.41 books, abandoned) and ATHRUZ (cl.41 e-publishing, cancelled). One abandoned Arabic-script mark transliterated 'ATHARI' (cl.25).
Phonetic neighbour ATHER (Ather Energy, Reg. 7451844/7435200, cl.9/35/37/42) is for EV two-wheelers - unrelated goods.
athar_applications: US risk for 'ATHAR' + distinctive element in classes 9/28/41 appears low on this preliminary search; THE ATHAR FOUNDATION (cl.41 education) is the nearest - counsel should assess overlap with ATHAR's educational services.
limitations: Search index only (not TSDR documents); no common-law/state search; phonetic equivalents (e.g. ATHER, AETHER) partly screened; results change as filings arrive.

title: WIPO Madrid Monitor - searches for ATHAR, ATHR, AATHAR, ATHAAR, ATHARR, أثر, اثر (brand and holder fields), 2026-10-27
edition_version: Queried 27 Oct 2026; control queries (SHERLOCK, sherl*, holder 'conan') returned hits, confirming the method
key_findings: Zero international registrations with brand text ATHAR, ATHAR*, AATHAR*, ATHAAR, ATHARR or ATHR, and zero holders named Athar; ATHR* returned only Athream, athree AAA and ATHRION (unrelated classes 1/5/25).

Arabic-script queries (أثر, اثر) returned zero - but control queries for common Arabic marks (الجزيرة, دبي, المراعي) also returned zero, so the Arabic-text index is unreliable and a zero here is not evidence of absence.
athar_applications: No Madrid-route ATHAR mark designates the UAE, KSA, Egypt, Jordan, Kuwait, Qatar or other states - but national (non-Madrid) filings in Arab registers are not covered and remain the main unknown.
limitations: Covers only international registrations under Madrid; national filings excluded; Arabic word search unreliable; snapshot only.

title: WIPO Global Brand Database, TMview/EUIPO eSearch and UK IPO trade mark search - automated-access check (blocked)
key_findings: WIPO Global Brand Database served an ALTCHA proof-of-work challenge page to the research client; UK IPO search served a CAPTCHA 'security check'; the TMview search API and EUIPO eSearch returned empty replies. None was bypassed.
Jordan's IPPD data have been in TMview since 23 Apr 2018 (146,000+ marks), so a manual TMview search covers Jordan in addition to EU offices.
athar_applications: These four searches must be run manually by counsel (steps listed in NAME_CLEARANCE_ATHAR.md section 6).

title: Enquire About Registration of Trademarks - UAE Ministry of Economy (and Tourism) service card
key_findings: The UAE's official clearance route is a paid informational search of filed and registered marks (fee AED 350), via the Ministry website/smart app with an external form on services.economy.ae; delivery listed as immediate.

The card states that a result (or no result) does not mean an application will be accepted. No free public browse of the UAE register is offered; the moet.gov.ae and moec.gov.ae portals timed out to automated requests on 27 Oct 2026.
athar_applications: UAE clearance for «أثر»/ATHAR must be done through this paid inquiry (or a local agent) in classes 9, 16, 28, 35, 38, 41, 42 before filing.
limitations: Fee and channel may change; ministry renamed (Economy and Tourism) - confirm current portal at filing time.

title: Federal Decree-Law No. 36 of 2021 on Trademarks (UAE) - English translation, Arts. 2, 3, 21, 24
title_ar: مرسوم بقانون اتحادي رقم (36) لسنة 2021 بشأن العلامات التجارية
publisher: FAOLEX (FAO) copy of official translation; listed by UNEP LEAP
edition_version: In force 2 Jan 2022; repeals Federal Law 37/1992
key_findings: Art. 3 bars registration of, among others: non-distinctive/common designations (3.1); signs offending public morals/order (3.2); public logos and symbols of the State or Arab/foreign organisations or their institutions, or imitations (3.3); marks identical or similar to symbols of a religious nature (3.5); marks identical/similar to earlier filed or registered marks for the same or related goods/services where a connection would be suggested (3.11).

Protection lasts 10 years from filing, renewable (Art. 21); a well-known mark owner may seek cancellation within 5 years absent bad faith, and a mark unused for 5 consecutive years may be removed (Art. 24).
athar_applications: «أثر» as a common Arabic word ('trace/impact') may face a distinctiveness objection if filed alone for investigation/education services - a composite or stylised mark is safer.
Art. 3.3 is relevant if «أثر» is perceived as a Dubai Police platform symbol; Art. 3.5 is a low but non-zero risk given the hadith-terminology sense of «الأثر» - counsel to assess.
limitations: English translation (not the authoritative Arabic text); executive regulations not reviewed; uaelegislation.gov.ae returned 403 to automated download.

title: SAIP IP Search Engine (Saudi Authority for Intellectual Property) - tools & research page
key_findings: SAIP describes an IP search engine at ipsearch.saip.gov.sa covering patents, trademarks, copyrights and other IP records in Saudi Arabia.
The search host disallows robots (WebFetch refused) and reset the connection to curl - it was not searched in this session; a manual search is required.
athar_applications: KSA ATHAR/أثر clearance must be done manually on ipsearch.saip.gov.sa (and confirmed by a Saudi agent) in the target classes.
limitations: Page does not state fees or login rules; actual coverage of the engine not tested.

title: Establishment of the Egyptian Authority for Intellectual Property (Law No. 163 of 2023)
key_findings: Law 163/2023 (issued 13 Aug 2023) creates the Egyptian Authority for Intellectual Property (EAIP), taking over IP functions from bodies including the Internal Trade Development Authority (ITDA) and the Patent Office, including registration and IP registers.
No public online trademark search portal is mentioned; the ITDA homepage (checked 27 Oct 2026) offers no trademark search.
athar_applications: Egyptian clearance requires a local agent search at the competent office (EAIP/ITDA transition) - no self-service check was possible.
limitations: Law-firm summary; operational status of EAIP in Oct 2026 not verified.

title: Launch of ATHAR: AUC's Teacher Hub for Advancement and Reflection

athar_applications: Same name in the same Nice class 41 field (online education, Arabic, Arab region) by a prominent institution - a real confusion point for an ATHAR learning platform in Egypt, even though audiences differ (teachers vs teens).

title: Domain and social-handle presence check for athar.* / athr.* (HTTP fetch of home pages; public profile titles), 2026-10-27
key_findings: Taken/active: athar.sa (AI and big-data consultancy, 'Create impact today for thriving future'), athar.ai (Islamic da'wa technology projects), athar.com (live page), athar.app (live page, no title), athar.io (minimal page); athar.org is listed 'for sale'; athr.com and athr.ai redirect to the Atom.com domain marketplace; athar.me points to an unconfigured Wix site; atharlab.com is 'Athar Labs' (custom AI consulting).
Social handles: x.com/athar, youtube.com/@athar and youtube.com/@AtharPodcast («أثـــر») are taken; TikTok @athar returned a generic page; Instagram rate-limited (429) - not determined.

title: أثر - definitions in Almaany dictionaries (معجم المعاني الجامع؛ قاموس المعاني)
title_ar: تعريف ومعنى «أثر» في معجم المعاني الجامع
key_findings: Senses listed: trace/mark left by something; remains/relic; footprint and tracking («اقتفى أثره»); impact/effect; transmitted report/tradition (hadith/sunnah sense); historical monuments/artefacts (آثار, علم الآثار); also a literary or artistic work.
athar_applications: The word fits ATHAR's concept (trace, tracking, evidence) very well - which is also why it is descriptive and widely used.
limitations: Aggregator dictionary (secondary); classical lexica (al-'Ayn, Lisan al-Arab) cited via ATH-SRC-2524.

title: الأثر (Wikishia Arabic encyclopedia entry: linguistic and hadith-terminology meanings)
key_findings: Lexical: al-Farahidi (al-'Ayn) - what remains of a thing; Ibn Manzur (Lisan al-Arab) - remainder, and also 'report' (khabar).

Terminology: Sunni scholars either restrict athar to reports from Companions (and Successors) or use it broadly for any report including Prophetic hadith; Shia scholars (al-Shahid al-Thani, al-Mamaqani) treat athar as more general than hadith/khabar.
athar_applications: «الأثر» is a recognised technical term of hadith sciences across Sunni and Shia usage - religious connotation is real but generic (not a sacred name or symbol).
limitations: Encyclopedic secondary source with a confessional editorial line; cross-checked with ATH-SRC-2525 for Sunni usage.

title: Idamat al-Nazar fi Tahrir Nukhbat al-Fikr (commentary on Ibn Hajar's Nukhbat al-Fikr), p. 67 - on the terms hadith and athar
title_ar: إدامة النظر في تحرير نخبة الفكر - ص67
key_findings: Applies the term «الأثر» to mawquf (Companion) and maqtu' (Successor) reports; reports al-Nawawi's statement that hadith scholars do not distinguish hadith from athar, while the Khurasanis reserve hadith for Prophetic reports and athar for later authorities.
The author concludes all such reports may be called athar, with 'hadith' popularly used for Prophetic reports.
athar_applications: Confirms the user's concern: in Islamic scholarly usage «الأثر/الآثار» denotes transmitted reports (including from Companions). A detective game named «أثر» is not offensive per se, but marketing must avoid wording that suggests 'investigating/verifying narrations' or casting suspicion on religious reports.
limitations: Modern commentary; publication year and edition not shown on the Shamela page; read via one page only.

title: Islamic Theology: Traditionalism and Rationalism
key_findings: Academic monograph on the traditionalist (ahl al-hadith / athari) versus rationalist currents in Islamic theology; chapter 3 'Traditionalism against Rationalism' (Crossref).

Scholarly background on the traditionalist (ahl al-hadith/ahl al-athar) current; the adjective 'Athari' (أثري) is used online as a theological self-label - this usage point is a research interpretation pending expert review.
athar_applications: Latin 'Athari'/'Atharism' and Arabic «أثري» carry a sectarian-theological marker online; avoid 'Athari' as a brand variant, handle, or player title (e.g. 'Athari detective').
limitations: Book not read in this session (catalog/DOI verification only); claim about current online usage of 'Athari' is a research interpretation.

title: Alternative-name screen for ATHAR: Apple App Store (AE, SA), Google Play (SA), USPTO, WIPO Madrid Monitor and .com/.app home pages for 26 candidate names, 2026-10-27
title_ar: فحص أولي لأسماء بديلة لمنصة أثر

key_findings: Zero Apple App Store title hits (AE+SA, Latin and Arabic) and zero USPTO/Madrid wordmark hits for: Qiyafa/قيافة, Muqtafi/مقتفي, Iqtifa/اقتفاء, Qaif/قائف, Qafa/قافة, Qarain/قرائن, Khafaya/خفايا (Madrid/USPTO; but Google Play has a hidden-object game 'خفايا'), Mijhar/مجهر (USPTO/Madrid; many 'microscope' utility apps), Istidlal/استدلال, Mustaqsi/مستقصي, Taqassi/تقصي, «مقتفي الأثر» and 'AtharLab'.

limitations: Screen, not clearance: national Arab registers not searched; Madrid Arabic-text search unreliable; Google Play only spot-checked; no common-law use search beyond web/app stores.

AUDIT-W2 2026-10-27: Re-screen 2026-10-27 (iTunes Search API, SA+AE): no title hits for Qiyafa/Qiyafah/قيافة/قيافه, Muqtafi/مقتفي الأثر, Qarain/قرائن - BUT the Latin variant 'Qeyafah' (Arabic «قِيافه») is a live App Store app (id 1508917144, DIGITAL ORBITS COMPREHENSIVE LLC, Shopping/menswear, updated 13 Jul 2026, 0 ratings). It is in a different class (retail), but the 'zero app hits for Qiyafa/قيافة' wording is too strong: spelling variants must be included in the formal clearance search.

title: Apple Developer Forums - 'App Name/ Brand Name already being used' (App Store Connect name uniqueness)
key_findings: Developers report App Store Connect rejecting an app name already used by another account ('already used'), with advice to contact App Store Connect support or change the name; Android listings are not considered.
athar_applications: Reserve the exact store title early in App Store Connect; a bare 'ATHAR' title is likely already reserved (e.g. by the French streaming app 'ATHAR' or Siraaj's game).
limitations: User forum, not official policy; Apple's precise uniqueness rule not documented here.
